name: skillradar
description: Discover, parse, safety-scan, classify, rank, inspect, and route Codex tasks to high-signal agent skills.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill for every Codex task
interface.longDescription: Route Codex tasks against a bundled, safety-gated SkillRadar registry first, with network fallback only when local data is unavailable. Explicit routing requests always query the bundled registry before local installed-skill availability is considered.
defaultPrompt: Query SkillRadar's bundled registry first, then find and inspect the best safe skills for this task
